# Review packet P2-verbal_en-01

Priority P2, domain verbal_en, 8 items. Status of every item: not approved.

**How to review independently:** answer every item below before opening the answer sheet. Then compare, and mark each item ACCEPT / FIX (say what) / REJECT in `decisions.csv` (one row per id). Do not edit the item files; the bank worker applies fixes as draft replacements.

**Check for this domain:** Answer from the passage/sentences only. Is the key the single best answer? Is any distractor also defensible?

## Items

### 1. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0001`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Which order makes a coherent paragraph about a barangay water interruption.
P. On Friday evening, residents filled pails and drums with enough water for the day.
Q. By Saturday night, the water was back on and the tanker left.
R. During the repair, a tanker truck parked at the barangay hall for those who ran short.
S. The water district announced a twelve-hour interruption for pipe repairs on Saturday.

- (A) S-P-R-Q
- (B) Q-S-P-R
- (C) S-R-P-Q
- (D) S-P-Q-R

### 2. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0002`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Choose the best sequence for a paragraph about renewing a driver's license.
P. At the LTO office, he first passed the medical examination.
Q. He left the office with a new license valid for ten years.
R. Ramon booked an online appointment two weeks before his license expired.
S. He then paid the renewal fee at the cashier and had his photo taken.

- (A) Q-R-P-S
- (B) R-P-S-Q
- (C) R-S-P-Q
- (D) R-P-Q-S

### 3. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0003`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Put these sentences in order to describe a new filing system.
P. Since then, retrieval time has dropped from minutes to seconds.
Q. Over one weekend, the staff relabeled and moved all the folders.
R. The supervisor proposed filing every folder by client surname instead.
S. The records unit kept losing folders because files were stored by date received.

- (A) P-S-R-Q
- (B) S-Q-R-P
- (C) S-R-Q-P
- (D) S-R-P-Q

### 4. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0004`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Arrange the sentences into a logical paragraph about a school feeding program.
P. Starting in June, every pupil received bread and milk before the first class.
Q. The school then asked parents and a local bakery to help.
R. Teachers noticed that many pupils came to class without breakfast.
S. By the end of the quarter, attendance and attention in class had improved.

- (A) S-R-Q-P
- (B) R-P-Q-S
- (C) R-Q-S-P
- (D) R-Q-P-S

### 5. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0005`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Which order makes a coherent paragraph about a typhoon response.
P. Once the winds eased, linemen restored electricity within two days.
Q. PAGASA raised a wind signal over the province on Tuesday afternoon.
R. The typhoon made landfall early Wednesday and toppled several power posts.
S. That night, the municipal disaster office moved coastal families to the gym.

- (A) Q-S-R-P
- (B) P-Q-S-R
- (C) Q-R-S-P
- (D) Q-S-P-R

### 6. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0006`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Choose the best sequence for a paragraph about an office energy-saving drive.
P. The agency's electricity bill rose sharply over the summer.
Q. She found air conditioners and computers left running overnight.
R. A shutdown checklist was posted, and the next bill fell by a fifth.
S. To find out why, the admin officer checked every floor after office hours.

- (A) R-P-S-Q
- (B) P-S-Q-R
- (C) P-Q-S-R
- (D) P-S-R-Q

### 7. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0007`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Put these sentences in order to describe a citizen's complaint.
P. A resident wrote to the city hall about a broken streetlight near the school.
Q. The crew replaced the faulty bulb and its wiring the next morning.
R. The engineering office logged the letter and sent a crew to inspect the post.
S. The office then wrote back to tell the resident the repair was done.

- (A) S-P-R-Q
- (B) P-Q-R-S
- (C) P-R-Q-S
- (D) P-R-S-Q

### 8. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0008`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Arrange the sentences into a logical paragraph about a community garden.
P. They then planted pechay, tomatoes and eggplant in raised beds.
Q. An empty lot behind the health center had become a dumping site.
R. Volunteers cleared the trash and tested the soil with help from the agriculture office.
S. Today the harvest goes to the center's nutrition classes for mothers.

- (A) S-Q-R-P
- (B) Q-P-R-S
- (C) Q-R-S-P
- (D) Q-R-P-S

## Answer sheet (open only after answering)

### 1. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0001`: key (A) S-P-R-Q

- Why correct: Answer: "S-P-R-Q". S sets up the situation, P and R are the next steps in time order, and Q gives the result.
- (B) "Q-S-P-R" puts the closing outcome (Q) first; the paragraph must open with S.
- (C) "S-R-P-Q" swaps P and R; P has to happen before R.
- (D) "S-P-Q-R" places the outcome (Q) before the step it follows (R).
- File: `docs/research/gap-fill-2000-05.json`
